title.zh: HR 顧問服務｜職級薪酬、勞動法遵與留任分析｜HiReKing
title.en: HR Consulting | Job Architecture, Pay, Compliance and Retention | HiReKing

desc.zh: HiReKing HR 顧問：組織與職級健檢、薪酬結構設計與市場對標、勞動法遵檢視、員工關係與離職分析，專為台灣科技與製造企業設計。
desc.en: HiReKing HR consulting: organisation and job architecture reviews, pay structure design and benchmarking, labour compliance reviews, employee relations and attrition analysis for technology and manufacturing employers in Taiwan.

title.zh: 招募解決缺人，顧問解決留不住
title.en: Recruitment fills the seat. Consulting keeps it filled.

sub.zh: 如果同一個位置一年換三個人，問題不在找人的速度。我們處理的是招募救不了的那一段。
sub.en: If the same seat turns over three times a year, the problem is not how fast you hire. We work on the part that recruitment cannot fix.

title.zh: 我們在招募現場看得到病灶
title.en: We see the cause from the hiring floor

body.zh:
獵頭是一個很特別的位置：我們同時聽到你的說法，和離開你公司的人的說法。哪些主管留不住人、哪個職級的薪水偏離市場、哪個部門的人在市場上被貼了什麼標籤——這些事，人選在面談時會告訴我們，但不會告訴你。

顧問服務就是把這些觀察變成可以行動的建議。它不是另一套通用的管理理論，而是從你自己的人才流動裡長出來的診斷。
body.en:
Search sits in an unusual position: we hear your account and we hear the account of the people who left you. Which managers cannot retain, which grade has drifted below market, what reputation a particular department carries — candidates tell us these things in interviews, and they do not tell you.

Consulting turns those observations into something you can act on. It is not another generic management framework; it is a diagnosis grown out of your own talent flow.

title.en: When to bring in a consultant

items.zh: 同一個職位一年換三個人。
items.en: The same seat has turned over three times this year.

items.zh: 薪水給到市場水準，人還是走。
items.en: You pay at market and people still leave.

items.zh: 職級混亂，加薪與升遷沒有依據。
items.en: Grades are ad hoc; raises and promotions have no defensible basis.

items.zh: 勞檢、勞資爭議或加班費計算讓你不安。
items.en: Labour inspections, disputes or overtime calculations worry you.

items.zh: 快速擴編，但制度還停在二十人的時候。
items.en: You are scaling fast on an HR system built for twenty people.

body.zh: 可單獨進行，也可組合成一個完整的組織健檢專案。
body.en: Each runs on its own, or combines into a full organisational review.

body.zh: 把「誰在做什麼、值多少、怎麼往上走」重新盤清楚。
body.en: Re-establishing who does what, what it is worth, and how someone moves up.

bullets.zh: 職務盤點與職責重疊分析
職級架構設計與職稱體系整理
bullets.en: Grading structure and title system design
Review of how headcount is actually allocated

body.zh: 讓加薪與 offer 有依據，對外有競爭力，對內說得出道理。
body.en: So that raises and offers have a basis — competitive outside, defensible inside.

bullets.zh: 與市場行情的對標分析
本薪、獎金、分紅與股票的結構配置
bullets.en: Mix of base, bonus, profit share and equity

body.zh: 在勞檢或爭議發生之前，先把風險盤出來。
body.en: Surfacing risk before an inspection or a dispute does it for you.

bullets.zh: 工時、輪班與加班費計算方式檢視
bullets.en: Working hours, shift patterns and overtime calculation

bullets.zh: 勞動契約與工作規則條款檢視
請假、特休與各項假別管理
bullets.en: Leave management, including statutory annual leave

bullets.zh: 競業禁止與保密條款的合理性
bullets.en: Reasonableness of non-compete and confidentiality clauses

body.zh: 找出人真正離開的原因，而不是離職單上寫的那一行。
body.en: Finding the real reason people leave, not the line on the resignation form.

bullets.zh: 結構化離職訪談與資料分析
留任風險評估與關鍵人才盤點
bullets.en: Retention risk assessment and key-talent mapping

bullets.zh: 部門別與主管別的流動率分析
bullets.en: Turnover analysis by department and by manager

bullets.zh: 員工關係事件的處理建議
bullets.en: Guidance on handling employee relations cases

title.zh: 四個階段，時程視範圍而定
title.en: Four phases; the timeline depends on scope

body.zh: 與經營層、主管與員工分層訪談，並取得現有的組織、薪資與流動率資料。
body.en: Interviews across leadership, managers and staff, plus your existing organisational, pay and turnover data.

body.zh: 把訪談所得與資料交叉比對，指出問題的實際成因，而不是症狀。必要時進行市場對標。
body.en: Cross-referencing what we heard with what the data shows, to identify causes rather than symptoms — with market benchmarking where relevant.

body.zh: 提出可執行的方案，包含成本估算與導入順序。我們會標明哪些是必要的、哪些可以之後再做。
body.en: Workable proposals with cost estimates and a sequence for implementation, marking clearly what is essential and what can wait.

body.zh: 協助制度上線、主管溝通與文件修訂。制度沒有人願意用，寫得再好也沒有意義。
body.en: Helping roll it out — manager communication and document revisions included. A system nobody uses is worth nothing, however well written.

a.zh: 不提供。我們做的是人資實務上的風險檢視與制度建議；涉及具體法律解釋、爭議處理或訴訟時，應由律師提供意見。必要時我們可協助你與外部律師對接，把人資面的事實整理清楚。
a.en: No. We provide HR practice risk reviews and system recommendations. Specific legal interpretation, disputes and litigation are for a qualified lawyer. Where needed we help you brief external counsel by organising the HR facts clearly.

q.en: Do we have to take the whole package?

a.zh: 不用。多數客戶從單一模組開始，最常見的入口是薪酬對標或離職分析——因為這兩件事最快看得到具體結論。
a.en: No. Most clients start with one module. The two most common entry points are pay benchmarking and attrition analysis, because both produce a concrete conclusion quickly.

q.zh: 顧問案跟招募案會不會有利益衝突？
q.en: Is there a conflict between consulting and search work?

a.zh: 有可能，所以我們把規則寫在前面：擔任顧問期間，你的公司列入獵才的利益迴避範圍。我們不會一邊幫你設計留任制度，一邊接觸你的員工。
a.en: There can be, so we set the rule up front: while we are your consultant, your company is off-limits for search. We will not design your retention system and approach your employees at the same time.

title.zh: 先做一次免費的初步診斷
title.en: Start with a free initial read

body.zh: 把你觀察到的現象講給我們聽——流動率、離職原因、加薪爭議。我們會告訴你這是制度問題還是管理問題，以及值不值得做一個專案。
body.en: Describe what you are seeing — turnover, exit reasons, arguments about pay — and we will tell you whether it is a systems problem or a management problem, and whether a project is worth it.
